subject: a tall stack of three thick, fluffy pink beetroot pancakes topped with a dollop of thick Greek yogurt, a drizzle of white cream cheese glaze, fresh raspberries and blueberries
hero_ko: 비트 반죽(핑크) + 요거트 돌롭 + 크림치즈 글레이즈 + 베리

geometry.silhouette: 3단 두툼 스택(약 2.5cm/장), 돔 윗면, 부푼 둥근 가장자리, 손으로 놓은 오프셋, 높이≈폭의 60%, 프레임 폭 65% 점유. 토핑은 전부 윗면에 얹힘(반죽에 박지 않음).
geometry.body: Three thick, tender pancakes stacked with a small, casual offset, as if placed by hand rather than aligned by a machine — the middle one shifted a little to the right, the top one a little back. Each pancake is a plump, pillowy round about 2.5 cm thick with a gently domed top and a soft rounded edge that bulges slightly outward where the batter rose in the pan; the stack is about 60% as tall as it is wide and occupies roughly 65% of the frame width, leaving generous empty background around it. The batter was blended with beetroot purée, so every pancake is pink through and through: the side wall of each one is a soft, even rosy-pink crumb (#E08AA8) with a fine open texture and tiny air pockets, a couple of slightly deeper magenta streaks (#C4548A) where the purée was folded in, no beet pieces anywhere; the top face is where the pink met the hot pan, so it has browned over the pink in a soft blotchy gradient — a warm rosy-brown (#A65A58) at the centre fading through dusky rose (#C97F8A) to fresh pink (#E08AA8) at the rim, with a few darker freckles, the way a coloured batter never browns evenly. A few tiny pinprick pores sit near the rim of the top pancake, barely visible. Where the pancakes touch, the top one presses very slightly into the one below, so the edges kiss softly instead of floating. The whole stack looks warm, tender and freshly flipped — the honest irregularity of a handmade bake.

toppings.label: YOGURT
toppings.text: One generous dollop of thick Greek yogurt (#FBF6EC), spooned rather than piped, sits slightly off-centre toward the front-left of the top pancake: a dense, matte, softly peaked mound with a spoon-mark on one side, its lower edge settling into a soft skirt against the warm pancake. Its clean white is the sharpest contrast on the plate against the pink.

toppings.label: CREAM CHEESE GLAZE
toppings.text: A thin, opaque cream cheese glaze (#F6EFE3), loose enough to pour, has been drizzled over the stack in two or three loose zigzag lines that cross the yogurt and the pink top, then spill over the front edge and run down the rosy side walls in slow, uneven drips of different lengths — one reaching the bottom pancake, one stopping halfway. The glaze is smooth and semi-matte with a soft sheen along the thickest ribbons.

toppings.label: BERRIES
toppings.text: Four fresh raspberries (#C8324F) — hollow-centred, their tiny drupelets catching soft highlights, one tipped on its side showing the pale hollow — and about six blueberries (#3E4A73) with a dusty grey-blue bloom, each a slightly different size, arranged in a loose cluster on and around the yogurt: two raspberries on top of the yogurt, the others tumbling down its side onto the pancake, one blueberry alone near the rim.

toppings.label: FINISHING
toppings.text: A light haze of powdered sugar over the far rim of the top pancake, away from the glaze. One small sprig of fresh mint with two crisp leaves (#3E7A45) tucked against the yogurt. The toppings gather toward the front-left so the browned pancake surface stays visible on the opposite side, and the composition reads as one deliberate, appetizing arrangement — realistic portion size, no duplicate identical elements.

materials_lighting: Premium food-icon look: slightly simplified, clean forms with believable, appetizing materials — matte tender pancake crumb with a faint velvety sheen only where it browned, dense matte yogurt, a semi-matte pourable glaze with a soft sheen, dewy raspberries and bloom-dusted blueberries, waxy mint leaves. Soft studio softbox key light from the upper left with gentle warm ambient fill, a subtle rim of light along the top edges of the stack, and a faint, soft contact shadow directly beneath the stack only. Appetizing food-photography color grading: warm, fresh, clean whites, saturated but natural colours, no colour cast on the background. Shot as if with an 85 mm lens at a comfortable distance, everything in crisp focus.
camera: Three-quarter top-front view, the dessert centered with generous margin on all sides.
background: Background: seamless solid pale sage (#DFEAE0), flat and even.
mood: a bright, playful brunch plate — vivid pink under clean white and berry colours — that makes you want to pick up a fork.

notes_ko: v5(2026-09-02): 리서치(med) — 비트는 반죽 착색(표면에 비트 조각 없음), 위에는 크림치즈 글레이즈 드리즐/요거트·휘핑 돌롭 + 베리·견과. 신선함 지표 = 선명한 핑크(갈변 금지). 윗면은 팬에 닿아 로지 브라운으로 구워진 위로 핑크가 비침. 정본 hex(ingredients/beet.json)는 스트리크에만.
